prompt: Cinematic painterly webnovel cover with dramatic film lighting, dark and glamorous: deep blue-black night shadows, a cold silver-blue key light from a rain-streaked window and a crimson rim light from behind, falling red rose petals and rain streaks catching the light, glossy wet highlights, shallow depth of field, rich contrast, a moody grade of blue-black, silver and crimson. Red appears only in the roses, the rim light, the lips or one red garment. Romantic tension, one frozen dramatic moment. The top quarter of the picture is plain dark shadow. No text, no letters, no logo anywhere in the image. The lead is Elena Ward, a bride on the night she turns thirty: a grown woman with a mature face and a full adult figure, dark brown hair in a low knot with one sprig of white wisteria and a few wet loose strands, dark eyes, red lips, diamond earrings, in an ivory wedding gown with a fitted lace bodice and a wide off-the-shoulder neckline that bares her shoulders and collarbones, and long lace sleeves. Behind her is Marcus Hale, a tall, handsome man in his early thirties with an adult build, sandy hair pushed back and light blue eyes, in a charcoal three-piece wedding suit with the tie loosened and a white rose in the buttonhole, his shirt cuffs showing an inch below the sleeves; his warm smile does not reach his eyes. Two adults, waist-up and close together in the lower two-thirds of the picture: the lead in front, facing the viewer with a defiant, glistening gaze; behind and to one side the other, half in shadow, one hand resting on the lead's shoulder. The top quarter of the picture is empty dark shadow. Elena stands in front, chin up, eyes bright with tears she refuses to let fall; Marcus stands behind her right shoulder, half his face lost in shadow, his hand resting on her bare shoulder. Only his hand touches her. Both are fully dressed. The moment is charged and romantic, a standoff. Behind them, a dark cathedral at night: rain running down the tall arched windows, silver-blue light through the glass, empty pews, red roses scattered down the aisle and red petals falling through the air, all softly out of focus. Colour palette: blue-black, crimson, rose red and rain silver-blue, with no warm candlelight and no gold.
